title: Forenzika, komunikacija i sigurnosne operacije
summary: Cloud forenzika (prikupljanje, akvizicija, očuvanje, chain of custody, forensic readiness), komunikacija sa dobavljačima, korisnicima, partnerima i regulatorima, te SOC, nadzor kontrola (IDS/IPS, honeypot, AI), SIEM i threat intelligence, incident response, procjena ranjivosti i pentest u cloudu.
summary_en: Cloud forensics (collection, acquisition, preservation, chain of custody, forensic readiness), communication with vendors, customers, partners, and regulators, and the SOC, monitoring of controls (IDS/IPS, honeypot, AI), SIEM and threat intelligence, incident response, vulnerability assessment, and pentesting in the cloud.
